name: Umi no Kanata ni Aru Sekai -The Future Beyond the Sea-
original_name: 海の彼方に在る世界-The future beyond the sea-
source:
A mysterious world lay beyond the blue horizon.
In the realm exists a school, and in that school vessels are built to traverse the two worlds.
Onward to the western realm. Onward to friendship, love, and the future.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100981.html]DLsite English[/url]]
